say: Fearless Ledger is a draft and early macro scouting tool for Cloud9 Kia's League of Legends coaches. It is built from GRID's official match data: 745 series and 1,739 professional games.
caption: Fearless Ledger: draft and early-macro scouting for Cloud9 Kia, from 1,739 pro games of official GRID data

say: Under Fearless Draft, a champion picked in one game of a series is gone for the rest of it. Coaches prepare for that with video review and spreadsheets. Fearless Ledger answers the same questions from data.
caption: Fearless Draft: a champion picked in one game is gone for the rest of the series. Today: VOD review and spreadsheets.

say: Pick an opponent, here FlyQuest. The report opens with a whiteboard of plain English habits. Each one shows the games behind it, and small samples are flagged.
caption: Scouting report: plain-English habits, each with the games behind it; small samples are flagged

say: Next, the role each pick slot goes to, from B1 to the red side counter pick, and their bans in each phase, by side.
caption: Which role each pick slot goes to (B1 … R5), and bans by phase and side

say: The priority table ranks every champion by presence, picks, wins, first picks and bans, and filters by role.
caption: Champion priority: presence, picks, wins, first picks, first-rotation picks, bans; filter by role

say: The Fearless section shows how a long series pushes them off their comfort picks. Player pools list each player's champions, win rate and last game, and mark players who left the lineup.
caption: Fearless shifts game by game, and every player's pool (former players marked)

say: Early macro: where their jungler starts, where the first clear ends, which lane they gank before eight minutes, and which objectives they take first.
caption: Early macro: jungle start and first clear, early ganks by zone, first objectives and timings

say: Draft prep compares them with Cloud9 Kia: ban targets with the reason for each, our comfort picks they tend to ban, and the champions both teams want.
caption: Draft prep vs Cloud9 Kia: ban targets with reasons, picks to protect, contested champions

say: During the series, the board records each game's draft. Champions picked earlier are locked for both teams, every player's remaining pool updates, and ban targets are recomputed from what is still available.
caption: Series board: earlier picks are locked for both teams; pools and ban targets update for the next game

say: It also checks our game by game plan, and warns when a champion is planned twice or is already gone.
caption: Our game-by-game plan, checked for champions planned twice or already gone

say: Under the hood, a Python pipeline built in PyCharm replays every GRID event feed, infers each player's role from the first eight minutes, and aggregates the numbers. The inferred jungler takes the first scuttle in 99.5 percent of games. PyCharm's inspections found 35 problems in the pipeline, and they were fixed.
caption: Built in PyCharm: replay every GRID feed, infer roles (jungler check: 99.5%), aggregate; 35 inspection findings fixed

say: The GRID data never leaves the local machine: the public demo shows aggregates only. Fearless Ledger was built with PyCharm and Claude Code. Try it at khozhijon dot github dot io, slash fearless ledger.
caption: Data stays local; the demo shows aggregates only. Built with PyCharm and Claude Code. khozhijon.github.io/fearless-ledger
